head_commit.message:
chore(deps): update Cargo dependencies to fix security vulnerabilities

Updates the following vulnerable dependencies:
- bytes: 1.10.1 -> 1.11.1 (RUSTSEC-2026-0007: Integer overflow in BytesMut::reserve)
- slab: 0.4.10 -> 0.4.11 (RUSTSEC-2025-0054: Out-of-bounds access in get_disjoint_mut)
- tracing-subscriber: 0.3.19 -> 0.3.20 (RUSTSEC-2025-0055: ANSI escape sequence log poisoning)

state: add memory consolidation lock primitives (#11199)

- add a migration for memory_consolidation_locks
- add acquire/release lock primitives to codex-state runtime
- add core/state_db wrappers and cwd normalization for memory queries
and lock keys

## Testing
- cargo test -p codex-state memory_consolidation_lock_
- cargo test -p codex-core --lib state_db::
